summary: CE-2 v1.1 Phase 3 (Workstream L HCP comparison + Workstream I PDF export) validated end-to-end. All 3 HCP visibility modes (always/toggle/never), all HCP dollar figures, grandfathered level override, and PDF download flow verified. Backend pytest regression 229 passed / 11 skipped (spec expected 190+).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: NPQ full-pensioner result screen shows $0/wk headline via the point-estimate 'PointHeadline' (not the fee-exempt headline). This is arithmetically correct (no-worse-off floor is 0% for full pensioners) but a caregiver reading it might expect the fee-exempt sage-band. Not in scope for this iteration but worth a UX polish pass in Phase 4.
PdfDownloadButton uses window.URL.createObjectURL + anchor click — good pattern. No issue.
ce2_pdf.py `_footer` uses datetime.now() (naive local) — for deterministic output consider passing effective_date; currently the pytest tests avoid asserting the date string so it's fine.
